DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope.

The clinical picture of syncope occurring immediately after voiding, with a rapid recovery and no prodromal symptoms, is classic for vasovagal syncope triggered by bladder emptying (micturition syncope). The normal ECG, troponins, and echocardiogram further rule out cardiac causes, confirming this reflex-mediated drop in blood pressure.
